name: Sweet Potato Sloppy Joes
desc: Whole30 sloppy joe filling of ground beef, peppers, tomato paste, and coconut aminos spooned into foil-roasted sweet potatoes.

source.title: Whole30 Sweet Potato Sloppy Joes
source.evidence: Same title and identical ingredient list and amounts (4 medium sweet potatoes, 1 tbsp ghee, 2 tsp sea salt, 1 lb ground beef, 6 oz tomato paste, 2 tbsp coconut aminos, 1 tsp smoked paprika) with the same 400°F bake.

ingredients.raw: 4 medium sweet potatoes, scrubbed and dried
1 red or green bell pepper, seeded and diced
2 tbsp coconut aminos (or soy sauce if not Whole30)
ingredients.note: or soy sauce if not Whole30

steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Prick each sweet potato several times with a fork, wrap in foil, and bake on a baking sheet until very tender when squeezed, 45-60 min.
About 20 min before the potatoes are done, heat the ghee in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the onion, garlic, and bell pepper, season with the salt and pepper, and sauté until soft, 5-7 min.
Add the beef and smoked paprika and cook, breaking up the meat, until browned with no pink left (160°F), 6-8 min. Spoon off excess fat.
Stir in the tomato paste and coconut aminos and cook until the mixture is heated through and coats the meat, 2-3 min. Turn off the heat.
Unwrap the potatoes, slit each down the middle, and push the ends in to open a pocket. Fill with the sloppy joe mixture and garnish with scallion.
tips: The Whole30 page starts from 1 lb already cooked ground beef and only warms it with the vegetables; this version browns raw beef in the same skillet instead.
Leftover filling keeps up to 3 days in the fridge.
